name: cache-live
description: A live prompt-cache timer for the status line. Arms the session's cache window from each model step's own API usage (main loop and subagent steps alike, so a turn the finished-turn event reports no usage for still re-arms it — a read or a write re-arms the provider's TTL), ticks the remaining time each second through the engine's own clock into a pinned line under the prompt: live at one refresh per second, with no status line script re-invoked and nothing parsed from transcripts. It also publishes the exact window (the last write, `expires_at` and the turn's usage) to a JSON file under the cache directory on every cache touch, so a status line script can count it down from an exact anchor instead of best-effort transcript guesswork.
